name: What are the primary benefits of building an ADU from my existing garage?

mainEntity.name: What are the primary benefits of building an ADU from my existing garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary benefits of converting your garage into an ADU include increased property value, potential for rental income, and creating flexible living space for family, guests, or a home office. It also allows for efficient use of existing property footprint, often simplifying the permitting process compared to new construction. ADUs provide a versatile solution for housing needs without the expense of buying a larger home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits of a garage ADU include increased property value, rental income potential, flexible living space, and efficient use of existing property.
